global_rules: Keep all 60 selected questions and all 240 episodes in execution reports.
Report ambiguous cases and task-local scope witnesses separately; do not relabel them based on prompt performance.
For unambiguous reference conflicts, independently queried SQL values govern the named semantic audit; released reference compatibility is a different column.
Entity lists normally permit deduplicated unordered answers; positional field associations must remain correct.
Numeric rounding must preserve a reasonable stated precision; report the original answer. Interpret 80 and 1980 as the same year where the SQL card verifies both stored fields.
For extreme-value cards listing all ordered rows, only maximal/minimal requested item(s) are required, not the entire diagnostic table.
Report output-budget hits and incomplete long lists. Do not call a generated prefix exhaustive.
A correct answer need not prove sufficient observed evidence. This policy does not assign a grounding score.
The dataset was unseen in our previous experiments, not guaranteed absent from model pretraining.
